name: io.github.mathbeal/avenir-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for YNAB: read-only by default, every change previewed and undoable.

environmentVariables.name: YNAB_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your YNAB personal access token (YNAB > Account settings > Developer settings).

environmentVariables.name: AVENIR_MCP_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the write tools; read-only otherwise.
